findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 46 requests to 19 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).

7 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising), chartbeat.com (Chartbeat, analytics), chartbeat.net (Chartbeat, analytics), doubleclick.net (Google, advertising), google-analytics.com (Google, analytics), googlesyndication.com (Google, advertising), permutive.app (Permutive, advertising).
